affix.simplysmith.lifesteal.desc: Restore %s health from actual attack damage; overhealing becomes absorption
affix.simplysmith.bloodrage.desc: Above 1 health, attacks cost 1 health and deal %s bonus damage
affix.simplysmith.experience_mending.des: While damaged, consumes 1 experience point per tick to restore %s durability
affix.simplysmith.immortal.desc: On death, remain at 1 health; cooldown is %s seconds (minimum 1 second)
affix.simplysmith.dodge.desc: Has a %s chance to evade all damage (maximum 99%%)
affix.simplysmith.flame.desc: Damaging an enemy sets it on fire for %s seconds
affix.simplysmith.frost.desc: Damaging an enemy freezes it solid for %s seconds
affix.simplysmith.lightning.desc: Damaging an enemy calls down a harmless bolt and deals %s lightning damage
affix.simplysmith.poison.desc: Damaging an enemy applies Poison III for %s seconds
affix.simplysmith.wither.desc: Damaging an enemy applies Wither III for %s seconds
affix.simplysmith.true_damage.desc: Damaging an enemy deals an extra %s true damage
affix.simplysmith.sharpshooter.desc: Damage you deal grows by %s per block of distance, counting from 2 blocks out
affix.simplysmith.backstab.desc: Melee attacks from behind the target deal %s extra damage
affix.simplysmith.nightingale.desc: Turns truly invisible while sneaking and immediately breaks combat. Attacking deals %s extra damage, reveals you, and puts the weapon on a 6 second cooldown
affix.simplysmith.chameleon.desc: Turns fully invisible while standing still, and reappears the moment you move
affix.simplysmith.refined_drill.desc: Raises the mining level of this tool by %s
affix.simplysmith.midas_touch.desc: Has a %s chance to drop a gold nugget when mining stone (maximum 100%%)
config.simplysmith.title: SimplySmith Configuration
config.simplysmith.affix_category.bias.t: Chance that each affix roll is drawn from the item's own category pool instead of the whole pool. Generic affixes count toward every category. Set it to 0 to disable category bias entirely.
jei.simplysmith.enhancement_stone.info: Use in an anvil to raise the gear's enhancement level by one and improve all of its affixes.
jei.simplysmith.breakthrough_stone.info: Use in an anvil to raise the gear's quality by one tier and add affixes; gear at the highest quality cannot break through.
